warnings: SAME GOING-NOT-RISER POINT AS THE LOWER FLIGHT - see that file's warning. 0.225 is the tread depth in plan.

THE LANDING LEVEL +2.49 IS THE ONE FIGURE THAT LETS THE STAIR BE CHECKED AT ALL, and it is consistent: the flight runs from the +0.60 ground floor to the +4.00 upper floor, 3.40 m in total, with the landing at +2.49 splitting it 1.89 m below and 1.51 m above. The sheet does not state how many risers make up either part, so no riser height is recorded - dividing 1.89 by the step count guessed off the circled digits would be inventing a dimension the drawing withholds.

The upper view carries two runs of circled step numbers side by side (the flight and its return past the landing). Recorded in the stair's description, not as per-step elements, same reasoning as the lower flight.
